subtitles.en: And right now we are two minutes away from the end of the trading day.
subtitles.zh: 现在距离交易日结束还有两分钟。

subtitles.en: Romaine Bostic here with Isabelle Lee taking you through to that closing bell.
subtitles.zh: 我是Romaine Bostic，和Isabelle Lee一起陪您到收盘。

subtitles.en: It's a global simile cast. We're joined now by Tim Stenevich and, oh, look at that.
subtitles.zh: 全球市场联动，我们请到了Tim Stenevich，看那边。

subtitles.en: Carol Maser actually decides to make an appearance this week. Welcome to our audiences across all of our Bloomberg platforms, television, radio, our partnership with YouTube.
subtitles.zh: Carol Maser本周终于露面了。欢迎各平台观众，包括电视、广播和YouTube合作伙伴。

subtitles.en: Here on a day where Carol Maser, the S&P, at least briefly traded above.
subtitles.zh: 今天标普指数一度短暂突破近期高点。

subtitles.en: It's most recent record high. All right, so briefly it's kind of like a meh trade, it feels like.
subtitles.zh: 但只是短暂触及，感觉交易平淡。

subtitles.en: Maybe it's just because we're getting to the tail end of earnings.
subtitles.zh: 也许是因为财报季接近尾声。

subtitles.en: However, having said that, what do we got? Cisco and a few other companies reporting.
subtitles.zh: 不过，我们来看看思科等公司的财报。

subtitles.en: We still have to get through what? Nvidia. We have to get through. Jackson Hole.
subtitles.zh: 接下来还有英伟达和杰克逊霍尔会议。

subtitles.en: Yeah. Yeah. Jackson Hole. That's right. I want you to talk about Jackson Hole.
subtitles.zh: 对，杰克逊霍尔，你来聊聊这个话题。

subtitles.en: I am. Are you kidding? He's been talking about it all afternoon.
subtitles.zh: 我？开玩笑吧？他整个下午都在说这个。

subtitles.en: Why wouldn't you want to talk about Jackson Hole? You go to the mountains in August.
subtitles.zh: 为什么不想谈杰克逊霍尔？八月去山里多好。

subtitles.en: Are you actually going to? I bet you meant like, is there going to be some market moving event out of this?
subtitles.zh: 你真要去？我猜你是想问，会不会有市场大事件？

subtitles.en: Oh, I don't know. I'm just curious about the fly fishing. This is a summit Michael McKeehole.
subtitles.zh: 哦，我不知道。我只是好奇飞钓。这是迈克尔·麦基霍尔的峰会。

subtitles.en: The fly fishing in the cowboy hats. Yeah. The vests.
subtitles.zh: 戴牛仔帽的飞钓。对，还有背心。

subtitles.en: The vests. Is that a requirement? Yeah. I think it is if you're a central banker.
subtitles.zh: 背心。是必须的吗？对，我觉得央行行长都得穿。

subtitles.en: Uh, okay. As a bell, take us, take it away.
subtitles.zh: 嗯，好。收盘钟响了，交给你了。

subtitles.en: I want to talk about the inflation print because of me. Oh, right. Okay.
subtitles.zh: 我想谈谈通胀数据，因为我。哦，对，好。

subtitles.en: She wants to do work. Okay. Interesting. What's up with me is Dan Swank.
subtitles.zh: 她想干活。好，有意思。我这边是丹·斯旺克。

subtitles.en: She's a chief economist and- Was it lame or tame? That's what I keep saying.
subtitles.zh: 她是首席经济学家——是平淡还是温和？我一直这么说。

subtitles.en: It was bang and line. I don't know. I mean, I guess- Bang and line. Bang and line.
subtitles.zh: 这真是精准命中。我不知道，我是说，我猜——精准命中。精准命中。

subtitles.en: The lingo on this show. Dan Swank said that it's still above the 2% target.
subtitles.zh: 这节目的行话。丹·斯旺克说它仍高于2%的目标。

subtitles.en: And it's been- Keep it clear. Yeah, I know. I got in trouble for them.
subtitles.zh: 而且一直——保持清晰。是的，我知道，我为此惹上麻烦了。

subtitles.en: None, none, none, none.
subtitles.zh: 没有，没有，没有，没有。

具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
